preflight_open_defects: [P5-T1] (spec D10) fix_all runs its test branches as concurrent threads; under the machine lock every later launcher step waits, exits 75, and fail-fast cancels the run. Serialize the four launcher test steps inside fix_all (in-process lock shared by the branch modules), add that file to P5-T1 and spec D10, and add a test proving no two launcher steps run at the same time.

[P5-T2] (spec D16, AC2) run_pytest_with_expectations in scripts/dev_tools/atomic_executor/qc_runner_expectations.py parses launcher output and reports exit 75 or 2 as a pass when expectations are set. Add that file to P5-T2 and spec D16, raise for return codes 75 and 2 before parsing, add a test with expectations set asserting exit 75 is reported as TEST_EXECUTION_QUEUE_TIMEOUT, and update the Execution Constraints Python production-file count.
